description:
Search volume and more for up to 60 known keywords: monthly Google volume (Google Ads' 12-month average, the source every AuditAE tool uses), the last 12 months, trend, CPC, ad competition, difficulty (0–100) and intent. Trends compare calendar months: monthly = last month vs the one before; quarterly / yearly = the median of the last 3 months vs the 3 before / a year earlier.

Billing: 10¢ per call (1–60 keywords). Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call within 24h is free. No-account server: one free data call a day without credit.

When to call: volumes and difficulty for a list you already have. New ideas around a topic: keyword_research.

Returns { country, volume_source, keywords: [{keyword, search_volume, monthly_searches, data_through, trend_pct: {monthly, quarterly, yearly}, cpc_usd, competition, keyword_difficulty, intent}], not_found, not_found_detail, cached, charged_cents }. intent is corrected by the query's words, so a singular and its plural agree. not_found: no Google Ads volume in this country (too rare, too new, or counted under a close variant); Search Console can still show impressions for one.

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default US.

name: get_keyword_metrics
title: Search volume, CPC and difficulty for keywords
